title: Recorded calls of AnalyticsEvent: what each operation was given and what it returned

states.title: find called with a stored id returns that events row, and with an unknown id returns null
findBy called with a timestamp returns the events rows that have it, and with no match returns an empty list
create called with a new event returns the row the adapter stored
update called with a patch returns the updated row, and with an unknown id returns null
delete called for a stored id returns true, and for an id already removed returns false
create called while the adapter fails rejects with the same error the adapter raised
